title: Lesson 5 - Purpose of Each OmniStudio Tool: FlexCards, OmniScripts, Integration Procedures, Data Mappers
description: Explain the purpose of Flexcards, Omniscript, Integration procedures, and Data Mapper.

questions.question: A client needs to display a compact account summary on a record page with no user input. Which OmniStudio tool is the right choice?
questions.explanation: A FlexCard is the reusable, data-driven UI component for displaying a record or set of records, which is exactly the display-only need here. Option A is wrong because an OmniScript is for guided multi-step capture, not display. Option C is wrong because an Integration Procedure is a server-side orchestration with no UI. Option D is wrong because a Data Mapper transforms data rather than displaying it.

questions.question: A client needs a guided, multi-step onboarding flow with validation and branching between steps. Which OmniStudio tool is the right choice?
questions.explanation: An OmniScript is the guided, multi-step user journey that walks a user through a business process with validation and branching, which is exactly this need. Option A is wrong because a FlexCard displays data rather than guiding steps. Option B is wrong because a Data Mapper transforms data. Option D is wrong because an Integration Procedure is a server-side orchestration without a user interface.

questions.question: A client needs to call an external billing system to fetch pricing, with no user interface involved. Which OmniStudio tool is the right choice?
questions.explanation: An Integration Procedure is the server-side orchestration for calling external systems, which is exactly a system-to-system pricing call with no UI. Option B is wrong because a FlexCard is a UI display component. Option C is wrong because an OmniScript is a user-facing journey. Option D is wrong because a Data Mapper transforms data rather than making system calls.
